answer_1.quote: Text summarization is to automatically glean the most important concepts from an article, removing secondary or redundant concepts.

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation. we evaluate summarization quality by standard ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L ) on full-length F1. We then use BERTSCORE to calculate a similarity score between the summaries based on their BERT embeddings. We also evaluate with the latest factual consistency metrics, QuestEval.

answer_4.quote: We also assessed the generated results by eliciting human judgments on 40 randomly selected test instances.
answer_4.guideline: Two evaluations: (1) question-answering paradigm where participants answered questions based on gold abstracts; (2) scoring abstracts based on criteria.
